name: codex-presentation-director
description: Portable presentation direction with capability preflight, install guidance, editable PowerPoint, generated visuals, motion, and optional Three.js scenes.

interface.shortDescription: Direct polished PPTX, visuals, 3D, and motion
interface.longDescription: A lightweight presentation director that plans narrative and design, selects traceable reference DNA, routes work to presentation, image, HyperFrames, and Remotion capabilities, optionally uses Three.js inside Remotion for deterministic 3D video, and validates the final result.
defaultPrompt: Check required capabilities, prompt for missing providers, then create a coherent presentation from my content and template.
Redesign this deck while preserving its template, editability, narrative, and visual consistency.
Plan a product-launch presentation with original visuals, accurate architecture, and restrained motion.
